theme.title: Across the NBA
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: The chart shows four other Game 7 scoring nights. How many points did Stephen Curry score at Sacramento in Game 7 in 2023?
questions.context: Stephen Curry · Warriors at Kings · April 2023
questions.note: 50, the first 50-point game ever in a Game 7; Golden State won 120–100.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In Game 7 of the Warriors' first round playoff series against the Sacramento Kings, Curry scored a playoff career-high 50 points

funFacts.text: Curry was the first player to score 50 in a Game 7.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the first player to score 50 points in a Game 7

funFacts.text: He joined Michael Jordan with 200-plus playoff series points after age 35.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Curry joined Jordan as the only players in playoff history to record at least 200 points in a series at age 35 or older

questions.prompt: Dennis Rodman averaged 14.9 rebounds for the 1995–96 Bulls. What did he average in 1991–92, his first rebounding title?
questions.note: 18.7, the first of seven straight rebounding titles and almost four more a night than his Bulls figure.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He collected an astounding 18.7 per game, winning his first of seven consecutive rebounding crowns

funFacts.text: Rodman made his first All-NBA team during the season when his rebounding suddenly exploded.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: and making his first All-NBA Team

funFacts.text: Kevin Willis argued Rodman could focus so completely on boards because he had few offensive duties.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Willis lamented that Rodman had an advantage in winning the rebounding title with his lack of offensive responsibilities

funFacts.text: Detroit's bruising identity had already produced back-to-back titles while Rodman was developing as a defender.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Detroit beat Portland in five games and claimed their second title

questions.prompt: In the 2022 title clincher, Golden State went on an unanswered run of how many points?
questions.note: 21–0, after Boston opened the game 14–2; Golden State forced 12 first-half turnovers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The 21–0 run was the longest such run in modern Finals history.

funFacts.text: Boston opened the deciding game with a quick surge, but Golden State answered before the first quarter ended.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Boston took a 14–2 lead to start the game

funFacts.text: The Warriors' swarming defense forced repeated Boston turnovers before halftime.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Warriors forced 12 turnovers in the first half

funFacts.text: The Warriors were only the second visiting team to clinch an NBA championship on Boston's floor.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: This was the second time that a road team won an NBA championship in Boston

questions.prompt: How many more games did the 1971–72 Lakers win than the 1972–73 76ers?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.derivation: Los Angeles Lakers 69 wins (1971–72) − Philadelphia 76ers 9 wins (1972–73) = 60.

funFacts.text: Los Angeles swept its Western Conference semifinal series, 4–0.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Western Conference Semifinals: 4–0

funFacts.text: Philadelphia lost its first 15 games before the season unraveled further.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the 76ers lost their first 15 games of the season

funFacts.text: Veteran Hal Greer was the last holdover from the 1967 championship team and retired after the season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Only Hal Greer remained on the roster from the 1966–1967 NBA Championship Team

questions.prompt: With the 2016 Finals Game 7 tied at 89, LeBron blocked Iguodala. How many seconds were left on the clock?
questions.context: Kyrie's go-ahead three came later, with 53 seconds left
questions.note: 110 seconds (1:50). The Block helped Cleveland finish its historic Finals comeback.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: with the score tied at 89 and 1:50 remaining in the game.

funFacts.text: The Cavaliers ultimately beat Golden State 93–89.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Cavaliers defeated the Warriors 93–89 in Game 7

funFacts.text: The teams had scored identically through the first six Finals games.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: both teams entered Game 7 with the same total points scored through six games (610 points each)

funFacts.text: Kyrie Irving later drilled the go-ahead three over Stephen Curry.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Kyrie Irving made a go-ahead three-point field goal over Stephen Curry
